method: Static review of pinned source and current local Mot Router source; no external repository code executed, no installer, live model probes or VPS changes

applicability.feature: Dynamic catalog, endpoint metadata, availability and token limits
applicability.decision: Adapt metadata management for authorized provider integrations in Go
notes: Mot Router fetches the model catalog per ListModels call; the routing comment claiming a cache does not match this implementation
The public model listing appends hardcoded entries and suppresses a named model
Metadata presence is not proof of permission to use a model or endpoint

requirements: Bound download size and schema validation
Atomic cache writes, freshness metadata and last valid snapshot
One shared refresh for concurrent callers; no refresh storm on repeated errors

applicability.feature: SSE error, finish reason and reported usage normalization
notes: Current baseline acceptance still tests only HTTP 200
The existing audit demonstrates in-stream errors becoming empty successful completions
Preserve length/content_filter/tool_calls and cumulative reported usage; incomplete usage must remain unverified for token plans

applicability.decision: Adapt protocol translation while preserving the caller contract
notes: Current router loses several generation parameters and image content on the Chat path
The bridge itself omits tool_choice none and its Responses branch forwards fewer fields than its Chat branch, so copying the whole converter is insufficient

applicability.decision: Use bounded backoff and structured evidence without evading access controls
notes: The current source explicitly acknowledges multiple possible causes for repeated 403; the social post overstates the IP-quota conclusion
Keep final upstream status and correlation IDs
Use documented Retry-After where available; repeated access denial is not a reason to rotate sessions or IPs

applicability.decision: Configurable, model-aware policy; avoid silent budget expansion
notes: This raises the allowed output ceiling, not necessarily actual consumption
Arbyte token plans require respecting caller limits and accurate measured usage
Account for model output limit and remaining context; a universal extra 4096 is not a guarantee of visible output

applicability.decision: Claim reviewed; not a validated fix for Mot Router 403
notes: The check compares cipher arrays and extension-type arrays only
It does not establish full ClientHello equality or upstream authorization
The baseline names Bun 1.4.2; the package accepts Bun >=1.0.0, so runtime parity cannot be assumed for every allowed version
CLI identity impersonation to defeat restricted access is outside the supported integration scope

applicability.feature: Source-derived CLI identity and tool gate profiles
applicability.decision: Do not transplant client impersonation as an access-denial workaround
notes: Generic release monitoring and offline compatibility fixtures can be adopted
The source schema extractor is a purpose-built parser using regex and balanced syntax helpers, not a complete TypeScript compiler
Unsupported source syntax must be reported; successful extraction alone is not proof of a compatible request or authorized access

applicability.decision: Keep Mot Router deployment mechanism; borrow test-before-release principles
notes: The runtime updater fetches files from moving main and swaps files with separate rename operations
Per-file rename is not an atomic release switch; syntax checking does not prove semantic compatibility
Use a fixed revision, verified artifact, isolated tests, consistent SQLite backup and rollback that preserves later customer transactions

recommended_order: Correct baseline and SSE failure reporting
Preserve request parameters, finish reasons, tool histories and reported usage
Add validated catalog metadata with bounded disk cache and shared refresh
Add configurable backoff, correlation evidence and constrained release monitoring
not_validated: TLS capture on this laptop or VPS
Runtime memory/CPU overhead of an additional Bun process
Every upstream test assertion or installer failure case
